title: Discoloured Tap Water on Pulau Tekong on 20 November 2019
what_it_is: Discoloured Tap Water on Pulau Tekong on 20 November 2019

sections.label: Discoloured tap water at BMTC
sections.summary: PUB was alerted to discoloured tap water at BMTC Pulau Tekong, deployed water wagons, flushed the network, and restored supply on 21 November 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The Public Utilities Board (PUB) was alerted to discoloured tap water at some parts of the Basic Military Training Centre (BMTC) at Pulau Tekong at 7.30 am on 20 November 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: PUB officers were activated immediately to investigate the cause of the incident and deployed water wagons to provide temporary water supply to the servicemen on Pulau Tekong.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: PUB also worked with BMTC to flush the water supply network on Pulau Tekong and carried out water sampling tests in the network to ensure that the water is safe for consumption and within the drinking water quality standards under the Environmental Public Health Regulations 2019 and the World Health Organization (WHO) guidelines.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The water supply was fully restored at 9.30 pm on 21 November 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: PUB investigated and found that these minerals in the pipes serving BMTC were churned up, thus affecting the appearance of the water.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: As a preventive measure, PUB is working with BMTC to carry out cleaning of the water mains in Pulau Tekong during the first half of 2020, when there is a break in BMTC's training schedule.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: In fact, all drinking water is tested, whether they are on Tekong or the mainland, to ensure that they are potable and up to the WHO standards and the regulations that I have mentioned just now.
